acceptance_criterion: For a selected event and venue the screen shows one of: Suitable, Suitable with warnings, or Not suitable
test_name: shows Suitable with warnings, listing what could not be assessed apart from any reasons (K1 AC1)

acceptance_criterion: Not suitable is shown when expected attendance exceeds the capacity of the selected layout, a required facility is absent, a required accessibility feature is absent, or the requested period falls outside the venue's operating hours
test_name: lists every failing condition separately, in a fixed order

acceptance_criterion: Every failing condition is listed separately with the specific values compared (for example, expected attendance 150 against layout capacity 120)
test_name: fails when attendance exceeds the selected layout's capacity, returning both numbers

acceptance_criterion: All compared values are read from the event record and the venue catalogue; the coordinator does not re-enter them
test_name: offers submitted events to choose from, not drafts, and asks for nothing else (K1 AC4)

acceptance_criterion: The indicator is advisory: displaying it creates, changes, or blocks no booking record
test_name: creates and changes nothing: the venue's slots and the event are the same afterwards (K1-T10)

acceptance_criterion: When no failing condition exists, the result is Suitable and no reasons are listed
test_name: returns Suitable with no reasons when nothing fails (K1 AC6)

acceptance_criterion: CR-03: for an event with several venues, each venue is assessed separately against the layout, attendance, facilities and accessibility recorded on its own booking request (partly built: the assessment takes its requirements as a parameter; passing each request's own waits for L1 and L4 in Sprint 3)
test_name: assesses against whatever requirements it is given, so each booking request can supply its own (CR-03)
